low.description: Low model confidence. Prediction should be interpreted cautiously.

moderate.description: Moderate model confidence. Prediction has meaningful uncertainty.

high.description: High model confidence. This indicates strong model certainty, not guaranteed diagnostic correctness.

evidence.low_region_observation: Predictions below 0.70 showed approximately 55% to 57% accuracy across the tested ranges.
evidence.moderate_region_observation: Predictions from 0.70 to below 0.90 showed approximately 78% to 92% accuracy.
evidence.high_region_observation: Predictions at or above 0.90 showed approximately 94% to 100% accuracy across the tested ranges.

interpretation_note: Confidence categories communicate model certainty and must not be interpreted as guarantees of diagnostic correctness.
